prompt: Leave the voicemail where Dad confirms Sunday's game plans and also mentions your oil probably needs changing.
response:
*BEEP*

"Hey, it's Dad. Just calling to confirm we're still on for Sunday — game starts at one, so figure you'll come by around noon? I'll fire up the grill, get some burgers going before kickoff. Your mom says bring that dip you made last time, she won't stop talking about it.

Oh, and hey — when you were here last weekend I noticed your car sounded a little rough backing out of the driveway. When's the last time you got the oil changed? Check the sticker on your windshield. If it's been a while, just swing by Saturday and we'll do it ourselves, save you forty bucks.

Alright, that's it. Call me back or just text your mother, you know how she is. Love ya. See you Sunday."

*BEEP*
